Name: 10" Fat Boy Smoothing Blade
Description:
The Columbia Taping Tools 10" Fat Boy Smoothing Blade is designed for professional drywall finishers who demand excellent control, rigidity, and consistent results. Its innovative 2-piece composite construction creates a lightweight profile that remains extremely rigid, giving you the control and stability needed for precision drywall finishing.

The rubberized grip provides a comfortable, secure hold while helping maximize control during bedding, wiping down tape, finishing joints, and smoothing compound. The 7" size is ideal for detailed finishing work and tighter areas where precision matters.

Replaceable Blade Inserts

One of the biggest advantages of the Fat Boy Smoothing Blade system is its easily replaceable blade inserts. Instead of replacing the entire smoothing blade when the insert eventually wears, simply remove one of the end caps, slide out the worn insert, and slide in a new one.

This innovative design helps extend the life of your tool and significantly reduce replacement costs, allowing you to replace only the component that needs attention.

The Fat Boy Smoothing Blade family is available in sizes from 7" to 48", providing the right tool for virtually every stage of drywall finishing—from bedding and wiping down tape to finishing drywall joints and smoothing wider areas.

Key Features

  • 10" smoothing blade ideal for precision finishing and tighter areas

  • Ideal for bedding and wiping down tape
  • Excellent for finishing drywall joints and smoothing compound

  • Inserts can be replaced quickly by removing an end cap and sliding the insert in or out
  • Replace the insert instead of the entire blade for significant cost savings
